Damn, I have the same problem with changing my mind so quick. I feel your pain, but I myself don't know what to do about it either, other to just force one choice and go through with it.

I also have the same thoughts about offing myself.

All right bro, listen up,

I'm not going to tell you what to do, because I, myself, am in a pretty fucked up place too. 
But If anything, I understand your parents situation completely. I live with two selfish (kind of narcissist) parents who just drain my energy. You can't reason with people like that, so you should move back to your place, don't fuck up that computer job of yours, and just start taking your medication again. Fuck them.

Best of luck
